concept: A laser-referenced screed-head teaching rig moves vertically against an independent datum; a twin-rotor trowel works a sample slab and reveals why timing and geometric coverage are different questions.
layout: One 16:9 viewport, three sequential experiments, no vertical scroll; light/dark themes; self-contained HTML.

model.datum: Design elevation is zero. Receiver reading e = head - laser. Closed loop head moves toward laser with a 0.8 s illustrative time constant and 8 mm/s rate limit. Independent error = head - design. Display displacement magnified 1.6 world units/mm.
model.timing: Early / ready / late are illustrative material-state presets, not elapsed times or strength predictions. No numerical quality score.
model.coverage: Union of two swept circular tool footprints on a 4.8 by 3.2 m teaching coupon, sampled on a fixed 80 by 54 grid. Guard envelope sets a 0.20 m boundary inset. Coverage is geometry only.

sources: ../../../任务5-3_混凝土泵送布料与整平抹光机器人.md
